Fluid restriction is one of the most diﬃ  cult diet modiﬁ cations

on ﬂ uid restriction, the clinician should make sure the patient 
understands the speciﬁ c volume that is allowed, what items are

trolling thirst. Visually demonstrating the amount of ﬂ uid the 
patient is allowed may support the patient’s understanding and
compliance. All beverages and foods such as soups, Popsicles®,
sherbet, ice cream, yogurt, custard, and gelatin should be 
counted within the ﬂ uid allowance. Finally, good mouth care,
